menu_list_delegate.behavior: A pressed leaf item calls model.trigger() on release and sets kicker.expanded=false.

menu_grid_delegate.behavior: A pressed grid item calls model.trigger() on release and toggles the root popup.

conclusion: The native release handlers identify where activation occurs. Because the first release closes/toggles the popup, this static inspection does not prove that a double click causes two launches or a Plasma crash. The affected menu, application and timing remain necessary to correlate the report.
